children: India has cut the basic import duty on crude and refined edible oils, including palm oil, soyoil and sunflower oil, the government said in a notification late on Wednesday, as it seeks to lower prices during the peak festive season.
The basic import duty on crude palm oil and crude soyoil has been reduced to 5% from 10%, the notification said.
